# 由历史摘要构造局部规律的精确条件 / Exactness of a local law derived from history summaries

## 主张 Claim

给定前缀封闭历史族L和摘要q，从所有已接纳单步延伸构造的局部规律，在每个已接纳历史处精确保留全部有限接续，当且仅当同码历史具有相同接续剖面。 / For a prefix-closed language L and summary q, the local law constructed from admitted one-step extensions preserves all finite continuations at every admitted history exactly iff histories sharing a code have identical continuation profiles.

Canonical source: [DerivedHistoryLaw.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/DerivedHistoryLaw.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 任意事件类型、摘要类型、历史族L及前缀封闭；q为全定义摘要。无需有限性、可判定性或L接受空词。 / Arbitrary event and summary types, a prefix-closed language L, and a total summary q. No finiteness, decidability or empty-word membership is required.
- 充要条件量化每个已接纳历史；不把只从一个初始代码精确当作同一条件。 / The equivalence quantifies every admitted history; exactness from only one initial code is a different contract.

历史和摘要描述同一展开；L的实际可接纳含义和字母划分保持给定。构造不创造实际可能性，也不证明所有过程都具有这个有限词表示。 / Histories and summaries describe one unfolding; actual admissibility and the event articulation remain supplied. Construction neither creates actual possibilities nor proves that every process has this finite-word representation.

## 检验与边界 Validation and boundaries

Lean 4.29.1实际编译；6项新定理、5项定义，共11项新空审计，另43项继承空审计。首轮对照摘要编译引入propext；显式构造子分支修复后全空，失败记录保留。作者反审，无独立验收。 / Actually compiled with Lean 4.29.1: 6 new theorems and 5 definitions, 11 new empty audits plus 43 inherited empty audits. The first control-summary compilation introduced propext; explicit constructor cases removed it, with the failed record retained. Author counterreview, no independent acceptance.

只保证有限词存在可行性，不保持端点、分支身份、概率或策略。L为空时条件可真而无实际发生；普遍无假设根基仍未证。 / Finite existential word feasibility only: no endpoint, branch-identity, probability or policy guarantee. An empty L permits vacuous validity without occurrence; the universal assumption-free foundation remains unproved.

- 全部布尔词均接纳、只把[false]编码为true时，接续仍精确而编码端点可以错误；错误合并不同剖面则产生具体虚假接续。 / Admitting all Boolean words and coding only [false] as true preserves all continuations but can misrepresent encoded endpoints; merging distinct profiles produces a witnessed false continuation.
